name: glider-feedback-bench-suite
description: A suite for evaluating models' ability to incorporate feedback and iteratively improve responses. It provides tasks/examples where models receive corrective or preference feedback and are expected to revise outputs accordingly, enabling assessment of feedback-guided refinement and alignment. Useful for research on instruction following, preference learning, and human-in-the-loop model improvement.
reputation: A niche benchmark aimed at feedback-driven evaluation with modest adoption among researchers focused on alignment and instruction-following.
